entities.summary:
Natisha Hiedeman is an American professional basketball player for the Minnesota Lynx of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and for the Hive of Unrivaled. She was drafted with the eighteenth overall pick in the 2019 WNBA draft, which is the highest of any Marquette basketball player in school history 
and the highest draft pick for the Big East Conference since conference re-alignment.
